positions.description: Problem solved and acted as an additional staff member to all production departments who needed additional support or needed something done but didn't have time to go do it.

positions.title: Conference Production Manager
positions.description:
- Production Manager for 2012 National Conference in Boston + 2013 National Conference in Dallas.
- Coordinated and scheduled all audio visual needs for 29 rooms in 7 venues.
- Oversaw production of full conference sessions in ballroom and traditional theatrical spaces.
- Worked with a variety of hotel and venue departments.
- Produced iMag, live-stream, and archival footage of conference plenary sessions.

positions.title: Event Supervisor/Production Office Assistant
positions.description:
* Provide technical support to events on all 6 stages operated by OOTA.
* Work with visiting companies and clients to solve problems they encounter in OOTA facilities.
* Maintain OOTA gear and spaces.
* Supervise large events in the Paramount Center and Tufte PPC.
* Coordinated with video producers for televised, live streamed, and archival filmed events.

positions.title: Production Coordinator + Audio Assistant
positions.description:
- Production Supervisor for "Small Steps" on the Paramount Mainstage, and "Newfest '13" in the Jackie Liebergott Black Box
- Production Coordinator for Performing Arts curricular projects.
- Production Sound Engineer for The Golden Age, Newfest '11, The Hallway Plays, She Loves Me, Newfest '12, Tartuffe, and Cafe Variations (co-produced with SITI Company)
- FOH Mix Engineer for Two Gentlemen of Verona: The Musical.
- Maintained audio and tech setup schedules for Emerson Stage, as well as coordinated use of shared resources and equipment, including maintenance.

positions.title: Producing Director
positions.description:
I founded Loudmouth Collective with Artistic Director Natalie Novacek as an artist-centric company, bringing solo & small ensemble shows to audiences eager for unfiltered, succinct, & ballsy performances.

In our first two seasons we produced four highly regarded "fringe" shows in the Minneapolis community. I provided strategic oversight to the formation of the new company as well as direct production support when possible. In 2013, I left my position as producing director to take a seat on the board of directors,

positions.title: FOH Coordinator
positions.description:
* House Manager for Rarig Xperimental (2010)
* Advanced venues and lobbies, and planning crowd control strategies.
* Scheduled over 500 volunteers for an 11 day festival.
* Supported field house managers during the festival.
* Created an online training module to prepare 200+ volunteers to be front line box officers.
* Led box office operations management team.

projects.title: TCG 2013: Opening Assembly: Innovation In Action
projects.description:
The Opening Assembly of the 2013 TCG National Conference in Dallas was our most challenging session, both technically and logistically. Taking place in the Winspear Opera House in the Arts District of Dallas, we had a multi-media performance art piece by Natasha Tsakos, monologues by Will Power, and a panel moderated by Desdemona Chiang.

This program involved coordinating with many artists and speakers, their agents, the staff at AT&T Performing Arts Center, and their IATSE stage crew.

projects.title: Small Steps Production Portal
projects.description:
This very simple production portal was developed for Emerson Stage's production of Small Steps. The website was designed to provide quick access to the daily work schedule as well as any necessary production documents at all times. 

This was particularly helpful for the Paramount Theater staff. Since they are often advancing three-four shows and have another two-four in their venues at any time, they receive a lot of email. Having a single URL that was easily memorable that always had the schedule for the next day on it was very convenient, with very little maintenance cost.
